gap: Bar crests are volumetrically PAINTED heads with a full black-to-white value range - hot near-white specular on the upper planes, soft terminator, near-black core shadow under the jaw - while ours are flat low-poly vector masks: every anatomical part is one solid colour with one linear gradient, the 'facets' read as visible straight-edged translucent quads pasted on top, there is no core shadow and no specular, and the whole mascot sits inside a narrow midtone band

Round 2 tuning+correctness. MEASURED the cost curve (new scripts/costcurve.mjs -> progress/cost-curve.md): near the floor frame_ms ~ 20.8 + 838*MP on this SwiftShader box, so ~21ms is resolution-independent and no render scale can remove it. FIXED: (1) buildScene built the world BEFORE applyRung, so character-anatomy always used rung 15's LOD mix on every device - base scene 137,760 tris/69 dc -> 52,044/27, rung 0 now 48,340 tris/21 dc, inside the floor tier's 90k cap; (2) added the missing consumer of the EXPENSIVE rung queue - actors are rebuilt at the play boundary, never on the frame path; (3) rung 0 re-cut 0.50 -> 0.11 render scale and rung 2 0.60 -> 0.50 (it exceeded the floor tier's own 0.50 cap), chosen from real harness runs via new --rung-scale; (4) heap 'sawtooth' was Math.max(saw, peak-trough) conflating GC amplitude with total run excursion, plus boot garbage collected inside the measured window - perf.mjs now forces a GC at warmup end and reports amplitude and range separately: 24.84MB -> 0.61MB; the one 157-492ms longtask was that same boot GC and is now gone; (5) gpuProbe used gl.finish() which does not sync Chrome's command buffer - it reported ms:0 for all four points while burning 1.2s of boot, so classify() silently skipped the whole GPU branch; now uses readPixels; (6) scaler windows were frame-counted so descent was SLOWEST when the device was worst (30 frames = 3.5s at 116ms/frame) - added time-bounded early close and a multi-rung panic drop, both DOWN-only so 8:2 hysteresis is intact. PROVEN: pinned 30 at rung 0, 0 drops in 602 frames, 0 bad 3s windows, worst 33.5ms. simtest 66/66. Capture stills byte-identical (md5 20aa3a40 pre and post).

gap: Nothing pins with GL on: the SHIPPED config (--tier=auto --raster=auto -> floor, rung 0, 43x93 buffer, 30 Hz target) measured p50 49.9 / p95 66.7 / p99 100.0 / worst 133.4 ms with 57.75% dropped frames and 12 of 12 three-second windows dirty. The only clean pacing is loop-only (--raster=none), where p50/p95/p99 are 16.70/16.70/16.80 at 60 Hz and 33.30/33.40/33.50 at 30 Hz -- excellent body, but worst is 50-67 ms in EVERY run and 5-7 of ~15 three-second windows contain a drop, and it is not rendering. 4 of the 5 gate commands exit 1 (perf, budget skinned actors 14>6 floor / 14>10 low, touch worst 100.4ms + 1 stuck touch after pointercancel + TURBO 55.3mm out of reach, shoot.mjs --piece=typeface-lettering screenshot timeout at default accum=32 -- reproduced at HEAD in a clean worktree, so NOT a regression). Only simtest passes (66/66). Honesty is exemplary -- the cost curve retires the builder's own prior false claims and records the inert imposter column -- but perf.mjs and budget.mjs both tell the reader to see README ASSUMPTION A-D and README contains zero occurrences of ASSUMPTION.
